content: समाम्नायः .²1 Traditional repetition or mention, handing down traditionally. .²2 A traditional collection (of words <ab>&c.</ab>); अश्व इति पशुसमाम्नाये पठ्यते <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²3 Tradition, repetition (in general). .²4 Reading, recitation, enumeration. .²5 Totality, an aggregate, a collection; अक्षरसमाम्नायम् <ls>Śik. 57</ls> ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} the letters from अ to ह which are said to have been revealed by Śiva to Pāṇini); वाचं वर्णसमाम्राये तमोङ्कारे स्वरे न्यसेत् <ls>Bhāg. 7. 15. 53</ls>. .²6 An epithet of Śiva. .²7 The sacred text (like Veda) in general; पुत्र्याः समाम्नायविधौ प्रतीतः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 22. 16</ls>.
